owner: Dept D Pre-registration Officer (draft for the Director; batch 1b, prescreen #1)
hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. Hong-Wang (2000) periodic market closure: inventory risk over the close makes the close-to-open move of each index overshoot relative to its peers, and the following open-to-close session reverses the relative overnight winners and losers (Della Corte, Kosowski and Wang, 'Market Closure and Short-Term Reversal', CO-OC strategy on 35 CME futures incl. S&P500, NASDAQ, DJIA, S&P400, NIKKEI 225; 1982-2014). This row is the FTMO index-CFD version measured on the US cash clock (as DKW measured NIKKEI at CME hours). Sign fixed in advance: LONG the index with the most negative standardised overnight return, SHORT the one with the most positive.
rules: Clock: every time below is America/New_York, converted per day with zoneinfo and applied to HistData bars whose ts is bar-open UTC (clock histdata_rule, D-019). Price P_i(t) = OPEN of the 1m bar of instrument i whose open time is t (bid). Trading days d = full XNYS sessions (exchange_calendars); skip d if d or the previous XNYS session d-1 is an early close. Universe U = {SPX (US500), NSX (US100), JPX (JP225), UKX (UK100), FRX (FRA40), GRX (GER40), ETX (EU50)}; HKX (HK50) is EXCLUDED by construction because its HistData file has no bars between about 17:00 and 01:15 UTC (QA delivered-hours table), i.e. none during the US cash session. Reference close C_i(d-1) = P_i(15:55) on d-1; if the 15:55 bar is missing, the open of the first existing bar in 15:56..15:58; else the instrument is ineligible on d. Signal price S_i(d) = P_i(09:31) on d (no fallback). Overnight return CO_i(d) = ln(S_i(d)/C_i(d-1)). Standardisation z_i(d) = CO_i(d)/s_i(d), s_i(d) = sqrt(EWMA, centre of mass 60, of CO_i^2 over the instrument's eligible days through d-1), at least 40 prior eligible days. Eligibility on d: C_i(d-1) and S_i(d) exist, s_i(d) defined, the entry bar 09:32 exists, at least 300 of the 384 bars 09:31..15:54 exist, and the instrument is inside its usable span (GRX excluded 2020-06-15..2023-12-01 and ETX after 2018-12-14 per data/qa; no bar from an excluded span is used). Trade only if at least 4 instruments are eligible. If two instruments tie on z, the one earlier in the list U order wins. LONG L = argmin z_i(d), SHORT S = argmax z_i(d); the two cross-sectional extremes are traded every eligible day, whatever the signs of z_L and z_S (no threshold). ENTRY both legs at the open of the 09:32 bar (one-bar delay after the 09:31 signal price). EXIT both legs at the open of the 15:55 bar (fallback: first existing bar in 15:56..15:58; else the close of the last bar in 15:45..15:54, counted and reported). Day P&L = w_L * ln(P_L(exit)/P_L(entry)) - w_S * ln(P_S(exit)/P_S(entry)) - costs. No stops, no targets, no pyramiding; flat every day before 16:00 ET. Returns are in each index's own currency; FX translation of intraday P&L is ignored (second order).
parameters: clock America/New_York; signal 15:55(d-1) -> 09:31(d); entry 09:32 open; exit 15:55 open; z = CO / EWMA(com 60) RMS of CO; one long (min z) and one short (max z); minimum 4 eligible instruments; universe SPX NSX JPX UKX FRX GRX ETX (HKX excluded, no US-hours bars)
instruments: FTMO US500, US100, JP225, UK100, FRA40, GER40, EU50 index CFDs (tested on HistData 1m bid CFD-index quotes)
holding: about 6 h 23 min intraday (09:32 -> 15:55 ET), one long + one short leg per day, about 250 days/yr (about 500 round trips/yr)
vol_scaler: Leg weight w_i = (0.10/sqrt(252)) / sigma_i, sigma_i = EWMA (centre of mass 60 eligible days) s.d. of the instrument's own 09:32->15:55 log return through d-1 (at least 40 observations), so each leg targets equal intraday risk; no cap/floor; the pair is not beta-hedged.
cost_model: 1x floors per briefs/00-common.md (index CFDs 0.5-1.5 bp per side), using the inherited D4-spec per-side numbers for the same CFDs: SPX/US500 1.0 bp, NSX/US100 1.0 bp, UKX/UK100 1.0 bp, FRX/FRA40 1.0 bp, GRX/GER40 0.8 bp, ETX/EU50 1.5 bp, JPX/JP225 1.5 bp per side, charged on each leg's notional at entry and at exit on top of the bid-to-bid return (HistData is bid-only); day cost = w_L*(c_L in + c_L out) + w_S*(c_S in + c_S out). No swap (flat intraday). 2x run attached (all per-side costs doubled). Futures-venue twin (AS C-4-01 on ES/NQ/YM/EMD/NKD 1h, blocked-paid ~$5) is a different dataset and would be its own row in this family.
decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos') per dataset in one run: pass iff (1) one-sided t of the net-1x daily P&L (Newey-West and stationary bootstrap >= 430,000 draws; the lower of the two) >= 3.6807; (2) net-2x mean > 0 (criterion 3); (3) criteria 4 and 7 of PARAMETERS.md (years, concentration incl. share of P&L from any one instrument pair, terciles, +-25% neighbours on entry/exit times and the EWMA centre of mass, one-bar delay) pass; (4) Red Team and re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read on the *_holdout datasets in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Anything else is 'refuted' or 'near-miss' (near-miss = t >= 2.0 with criterion 3 passed); the result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length. Sub-periods reported, not decisive: 2015-2019, 2020-03..2022-04, 2022-05.. (daily 0DTE), and GRX-hole years.
notes: Source: candidates.md rank 1 (AS C-4-01, the only 'medium' row), FTMO-CFD version named in the prescreen-2026-11-06 #1 row and Batch 1b list. EVIDENCE WINDOW: DKW, 35 CME futures daily open/close Jul 1982-Dec 2014 (full text read 2026-11-03, candidates.md); 2015-2026 untouched -> OOS 2015-01-02..2024-12-31 is not derivative; IS 2010-11..2014-12 overlaps the evidence and is IS by declaration. Institutional change dates: 2014-12 (evidence end, IS/OOS boundary), 2020-03, 2022-05 (daily SPX 0DTE) -> sub-periods. Closed families: H0012/H0017 (S&P time-series overnight-gap fade) and E1-08..10 (stock-CFD tug of war) adjacent, not inside: this is a relative, cross-index construction; D4-02 (open move -> rest of session, time-series momentum per market, closed) is a different sign and construction. Data (structure-only peeks, no returns): all seven CFDs carry bars through 09:30-15:59 ET (QA delivered hours: FRX/ETX 02:00-15:59 NY, the others ~24h); HKX does not, hence its exclusion; universe in OOS is 6 (5 during the GRX hole 2020-06-15..2023-12-01); ETX contributes OOS days only until 2018-12-14. UKX clock: QA verdict PASS on the London anchor and release votes (US-anchor peaks compete; the halt follows the London clock). OOS 10.0 years: bar 1.16 annual Sharpe; criterion-4 power 0.86/1.00/1.00 at true Sharpe 1.5/2.0/2.4; joint (criteria 3+4+7, costs 1/3 of gross) about 0.72/0.85/0.91. Economics: DKW 25 bp/day L-S gross -> 12.5 bp after the 0.5 haircut vs about 4.4 bp/day two-leg round trip at the 1x floors = 2.8x (just under the 3x certification line; the 2x run needs gross >= ~9 bp). HONEST POWER: the prescreen's prior P(edge exists) ~0.2 and joint power ~0.5 at the haircut Sharpe give ~0.1 expected passes; specific risks lowering it further: (a) DKW used daily 'open' prints, and a 09:32 fill on CFD quotes may lose most of the published reversal (bid-ask bounce); (b) US-clock European legs have their home close inside the hold, and SPX/NSX are ~0.9 correlated, so the long-short is dominated by a few relative pairs (Japan/Europe vs US); (c) costs are ~1/3 of the haircut gross, where the 2x criterion bites. Firm clauses touched: FTMO intraday (flat by day end; 00:00 CE(S)T reset is at 18:00 ET, after the 15:55 exit), 5% daily loss path-wise including floating P&L, FTMO funded +-2 min news rule: entry 09:32 and exit 15:55 are clear of 08:30 and 10:00 ET releases (none scheduled at 09:30-09:34 or 15:53-15:57); simultaneous long and short in different index CFDs is not hedging the same instrument (FTMO bans cross-account/cross-firm hedging only). Not suitable for futures firms as written (CFDs). Hold-out read needs the *_holdout datasets (in hand for all but ETX). Family xs-closure-reversal holds 1 of 5 counts after this row.
